# Hero full-body reference (human-provided, `full_body.png`, DVC-tracked; do not edit)

- Side view (profile, facing left), full body, plain dark grey background.
- Mesh/chainmail hood over a pale face; armoured torso of weathered dark metal with rust-orange wear; green box backpack on two straps, with a hose running up to the hood.
- Armoured thigh plates, wide and boxy, reaching down to the knee.
- Below the knee: thin mechanical shins bent backwards (digitigrade), no calf mass.
- Feet are reverse-C hooks of three nested curved blade tines each. The tines leave the hock going BACKWARD (away from the face), roughly level, and arch at about hock height. The outer tine reaches its rearmost point about 0.8-0.9 hock heights (H) behind the hock, at 0.6-0.8 H above the ground. The tines then sweep down, and the tips hook FORWARD at ground level, landing roughly under or just ahead of the hock (about 0.1-0.35 H ahead). Most of each foot's length is behind the hock. The outer arc is the longest and lowest (about 3 H path length) and is the one that touches the ground; the middle tine runs just inside it (about 2.5 H); the inner tine, starting at the hock spring, is the shortest (about 2 H). These are rough pixel-grid estimates.
